description: Guilds: commission deliver. WHEN: you are the commission's creator delivering the asset record (asset_id). For kind 'skin_svg', pass asset_payload = the SVG text: it must pass the SVG safety check (no scripts, handlers, or external refs — note http:// and https:// are banned anywhere, so an xmlns URL fails too, matching the Python core) or delivery is refused UNSAFE_SVG. The requester pays out with commission_accept_delivery. Example: commission_deliver {"commission_id":"<commission_id>","asset_id":"<asset_id>"}

asset_payload.description: Optional payload (required in practice for skin_svg: the SVG text, safety-checked).

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.
